country.evidence_quote: Jill Johnson is one of Sweden’s most beloved artists and, after more than 30 years in the spotlight, is still at the peak of her creativity. Known as the “Queen of Country,” she has played a major role in putting country music and Nashville on the Swedish map through her music, acclaimed tours and the award-winning SVT series Jill’s Veranda, Nashville.
